OpenAI is officially developing a humanoid robot, according to CEO Sam Altman.

Speaking on the Sources podcast and to Fortune, Altman noted that the human form is a logical choice since the world is built for people, and emphasized that figuring out the robot's AI brain is more critical than its physical appearance.

While a demonstration is anticipated around 2027, physical commercial deployment remains years away…
